Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a license fee or tax on certain businesses annexed into a firstclass city.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a license fee or tax on certain businessesannexed into a firstclass city; and adding a new section to chapter35.22 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.22 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any firstclass city in a county with a population greater than onemillion five hundred thousand that imposes a license fee or tax uponthe business activity of marine manufacturing and industrial businessesmay not impose a license fee or tax upon the business activity ofmarine manufacturing and industrial businesses that are annexed intothe city for a minimum period of five years from the effective date ofthe annexation.
